title: Workflow editor: Replace statuses
description:
Save time when editing your workflows in Jira by replacing an existing status with another one in a single action. This update allows you to swap statuses without manually editing transitions, helping you maintain your workflow structure while making necessary adjustments. Edit a Jira workflow.
	Select the status you want to replace.
	Select the replace option in the status details panel.
